muyesser-irab:1-1.t:
﴿ويل﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿لكل﴾: the lām is a preposition, and «كل» is a noun genitive (majrūr) by the lām, the sign of its genitive being the kasra; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of ﴿ويل﴾, and «كل» is muḍāf.
﴿همزة﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive by the kasra.
﴿لمزة﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿همزة﴾, genitive by the kasra; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:2-2.t:
﴿الذي﴾: a relative noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of genitive as a badal (substitute) for ﴿كل﴾; or in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "he" (هو); or in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, by way of censure (dhamm), i.e. "I censure the one who" (أذم الذي).
﴿جمع﴾: a past verb indeclinable on the fatḥa, and the agent is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو); the clause ﴿جمع﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿مالا﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) by the fatḥa.
﴿وعدده﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «عدده» is a past verb indeclinable on the fatḥa, and the agent is latent, its implied form being "he" (هو), and the hāʾ is a pronoun indeclinable on the ḍamma in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿عدده﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿جمع﴾, with no grammatical position. The clause ﴿الذي جمع...﴾, on the implied reading ﴿هو الذي...﴾, has no grammatical position, being a resumption by way of explanation (istiʾnāf bayānī); and on the implied reading ﴿أذم الذي...﴾, it is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿يحسب﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma, and the agent is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو).
﴿أن﴾: an abrogating particle indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, with no grammatical position.
﴿ماله﴾: the noun (ism) of «أن», accusative (manṣūb) by the fatḥa, and the hāʾ is a pronoun indeclinable on the ḍamma in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿أخلده﴾: a past verb indeclinable on the fatḥa, and the agent is latent, its implied form being "it" (هو), and the hāʾ is a pronoun indeclinable on the ḍamma in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿أخلده﴾ is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of «أن»; the clause ﴿أن ماله أخلده﴾ stands in place of the two objects of «يحسب»; and the clause ﴿يحسب...﴾ is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the agent of «جمع» or from the agent of «عدده», i.e. "reckoning that the wealth will make him immortal" (حاسبًا أن المال سيخلده); or it is a resumption by way of explanation (istiʾnāf bayānī), with no grammatical position, as if it were asked: "What is the matter with him that he gathers wealth and is preoccupied with it?" (ما باله يجمع المال ويهتم به؟)

muyesser-irab:4-4.t:
﴿كلا﴾: a particle of deterrence and rebuke.
﴿لينبذن﴾: the lām is the answer of an omitted oath, and «ينبذن» is an imperfect verb in the passive (lit. "whose agent is not named"), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو); the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the answer of the oath.
﴿في الحطمة﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿لينبذن﴾; the oath clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿وما﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and «ما» is an interrogative noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿أدراك﴾: a past verb indeclinable on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif, and the agent is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "it" (هو), referring back to «ما»; the kāf is the pronoun of the addressee, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿أدراك﴾ is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ ﴿ما﴾.
﴿ما﴾: an interrogative noun indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ.
﴿الحطمة﴾: khabar of the mubtadaʾ, nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma; the nominal clause ﴿ما الحطمة﴾ is in the position of accusative, standing in place of the second and third objects of ﴿أدراك﴾, and the clause ﴿وما أدراك ...﴾ is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from His saying ﴿الحطمة﴾ in the previous ayah, the link (rābiṭ) being the repetition of the word «الحطمة».

muyesser-irab:6-6.t:
﴿نار﴾: khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma, of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "it" (هي), i.e. "it is the fire of Allah" (هي نار الله); the nominal clause is a resumption by way of explanation (istiʾnāf bayānī), so it has no grammatical position. Or: ﴿نار﴾ is a badal (substitute) for «الحطمة», nominative by the ḍamma. «نار» is muḍāf.
﴿الله﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr), the sign of its genitive being the kasra.
﴿الموقدة﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of «النار», nominative by the ḍamma.

muyesser-irab:7-7.t:
﴿التي﴾: a relative noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of nominative as a second naʿt (adjective) of ﴿نار﴾. Or: in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "it is the one which" (هي التي).
﴿تطلع﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma, and the agent is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "it" (هي), referring back to the fire; the clause ﴿تطلع﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿على الأفئدة﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تطلع﴾; the clause ﴿التي تطلع...﴾, on the implied reading ﴿هي التي تطلع...﴾, is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:8-8.t:
﴿إنها﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, with no grammatical position, and ﴿ها﴾ is a pronoun indeclinable on the sukūn in the position of accusative as the noun (ism) of «إن».
﴿عليهم﴾: «على» is a preposition, the hāʾ is a pronoun indeclinable on the kasra in the position of genitive, and the mīm is the sign of the plural; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿مؤصدة﴾.
﴿مؤصدة﴾: the khabar (predicate) of «إن», nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:9-9.t:
﴿في عمد﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), either from the pronoun in ﴿عليهم﴾, i.e. "bound in columns of iron, shackled with them", or from the pronoun in ﴿إنها﴾, i.e. "the kindled fire is in columns". Or they are attached to a second khabar (predicate) of «إن», or to the khabar of a concealed mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "it is in columns" (هي في عمد), or "they are in columns" (هم في عمد).
﴿ممددة﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿عمد﴾, genitive (majrūr) by the kasra; the clause, on the implied reading "it is in columns" (هي في عمد) or "they are in columns" (هم في عمد), is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
